rows.grounds: past participle of pā (to drink), neuter nominative singular
compound paśu + pāna, neuter nominative singular

items.question: What kind of drinking is declared paśupāna?
premises: Drinking by own will like paśu is paśupāna.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of pītaṃ remains slightly unclear.
items.plain_english: Drunk by one's own will like a paśu, it is called paśu-drinking, thus declared.
